fields.name: halla
fields.meaning: hall sensor A

fields.name: hallb
fields.meaning: hall sensor B

fields.name: hallc
fields.meaning: hall sensor C

fields.name: ledr
fields.meaning: red LED

fields.name: ledg
fields.meaning: green LED

fields.name: ledb
fields.meaning: blue / orange LED

fields.name: ledu
fields.meaning: upper LED

fields.name: ledd
fields.meaning: lower LED

fields.name: buzzer
fields.meaning: buzzer

fields.name: button
fields.meaning: power button sense

fields.name: latch
fields.meaning: power self-hold

fields.name: charge
fields.meaning: charger detect (chargelevel, chargepull)

fields.name: vbat
fields.meaning: battery voltage adc

fields.name: itotal
fields.meaning: bus current adc

fields.name: tx
fields.meaning: uart tx

fields.name: rx
fields.meaning: uart rx

fields.name: iphasea
fields.meaning: phase current adc 1 (phase: iphasecfg)

fields.name: iphaseb
fields.meaning: phase current adc 2 (phase: iphasecfg)

fields.name: poskp
fields.meaning: position: 0.1 rpm per hall step of error; 0/65535 = default block 20, sine 60, FOC 133

fields.name: posrpm
fields.meaning: velocity limit (vel_limit) in position and velocity modes, rpm; 0/65535 = default 300

fields.name: motorr
fields.meaning: phase resistance incl. mosfets, mOhm; 0/65535 = default 300

fields.name: fwimax
fields.meaning: FOC field weakening: max negative d current 0.1 A; 0/65535 = off

fields.name: fwadvance
fields.meaning: sine field weakening: max phase advance, degrees electrical; 0/65535 = off

fields.name: ocp
fields.meaning: TIM1 break input (hardware overcurrent)

fields.name: ocpref
fields.meaning: overcurrent comparator reference

fields.name: itotalzero
fields.meaning: shunt zero below adc 0 (the adc clips), 0.01 counts; 0/65535 = 0

fields.name: torqueconst
fields.meaning: torque constant mNm/A (CANSimple torque units); 0/65535 = 8270 / sine kv

fields.name: curtrip
fields.meaning: phase current trip (current_hard_max) 0.1 A; 0/65535 = 2 x focimax, at least 15 A

fields.name: inputmode
fields.meaning: ODrive input mode 1 PASSTHROUGH, 2 VEL_RAMP, 3 POS_FILTER, 5 TRAP_TRAJ, 6 TORQUE_RAMP; 0/65535 = 1

fields.name: filterbw
fields.meaning: POS_FILTER bandwidth 0.01 /s; 0/65535 = 200

fields.name: trajvel
fields.meaning: TRAP_TRAJ velocity limit 0.01 turns/s; 0/65535 = 200

fields.name: magicnum
fields.meaning: 0xDCAB = valid

fields.name: vbatdivider
fields.meaning: vbat = divider * Vadc

fields.name: itotaldivider
fields.meaning: itotal = divider * Vadc (1/shunt ohm: R003 = 333; detect current with the shunt value)

fields.name: trajaccel
fields.meaning: TRAP_TRAJ acceleration 0.01 turns/s^2; 0/65535 = 50

fields.name: baud
fields.meaning: uart baud / 100 (config version 2: 192 = 19200, 1152 = 115200)

fields.name: pwmres
fields.meaning: TIM1 period 2048..16383 (17.6..2.2 kHz), read at boot; the control stays at ~4.39 kHz, FOC modulation limit 94 % at 8192, 76 % at 2048

fields.name: slaveid
fields.meaning: RemoteUartBus slave id

fields.name: windings
fields.meaning: motor poles

fields.name: invlowside
fields.meaning: 1 = low side gate drive inverted

fields.name: softocp
fields.meaning: A, averaged bus current limit, 0 = off

fields.name: hardocp
fields.meaning: adc watchdog current limit, adc counts above zero

fields.name: trajdecel
fields.meaning: TRAP_TRAJ deceleration 0.01 turns/s^2; 0/65535 = 50

fields.name: drivemode
fields.meaning: commutation*4 + control: 0 COM_VOLT, 1 COM_SPEED, 4 SINE_VOLT, 5 SINE_SPEED, 3/7/11 COM/SINE/FOC_POSITION, 8 FOC_VOLT, 9 FOC_SPEED, 10 FOC_TORQUE (control 0 pwm, 1 speed, 2 torque, 3 position; commutation 0 block, 1 sine, 2 FOC)

fields.name: batfull
fields.meaning: mV

fields.name: batempty
fields.meaning: mV, <= 20000 disables the low battery cut-off

fields.name: timeout
fields.meaning: ms without a command until speed = 0

fields.name: speedkp
fields.meaning: COM_SPEED: 0.1 permille duty per rpm, 0 = default 50

fields.name: speedki
fields.meaning: COM_SPEED: 0.1 permille duty per rpm*s, 0 = default 100

fields.name: speedkv
fields.meaning: COM_SPEED feed forward: 0.1 rpm/V at 100% duty, 0 = default 355

fields.name: speedd0
fields.meaning: COM_SPEED feed forward: dead band permille duty, 0 = default 53

fields.name: sinekp
fields.meaning: SINE_SPEED: 0.1 permille modulation per rpm, 0 = default 5

fields.name: sineki
fields.meaning: SINE_SPEED: 0.1 permille per rpm*s, 0 = default 85

fields.name: sinekv
fields.meaning: SINE_SPEED feed forward: 0.1 rpm/V at 100% modulation, 0 = default 242

fields.name: sined0
fields.meaning: SINE_SPEED feed forward: dead band permille, 0 = default 10

fields.name: iphasegain
fields.meaning: FOC: 0.1 mA per adc count, 0 = default 515

fields.name: iphasecfg
fields.meaning: FOC: phases on iphasea/b 0 = A,B 1 = B,C 2 = A,C; +4: adc rises with current into the motor

fields.name: focimax
fields.meaning: FOC: phase current limit 0.1 A, 0 = default 100; trips at twice that

fields.name: curkp
fields.meaning: FOC current loop: mV per A, 0 = default 400

fields.name: curki
fields.meaning: FOC current loop: V per A*s, 0 = default 300

fields.name: focspdkp
fields.meaning: FOC_SPEED: mA per rpm, 0 = default 30

fields.name: focspdki
fields.meaning: FOC_SPEED: mA per rpm*s, 0 = default 100

fields.name: cfgversion
fields.meaning: config layout version, migrated at boot: 1 drive mode numbers, 2 baud/100, 3 input mode words reset

fields.name: holdcurrent
fields.meaning: FOC position hold current (stiffness) 0.1 A, <= 90 % of focimax; 0/65535 = 40

fields.name: holdenable
fields.meaning: FOC position hold: 1 off, 2 on; 0/65535 = on

fields.name: holdwindow
fields.meaning: FOC position: hold within 0.01 hall step of the target; 0/65535 = 150

fields.name: posaccel
fields.meaning: FOC position approach acceleration / braking 0.01 turns/s^2; 0/65535 = 2000

fields.name: torqueramp
fields.meaning: TORQUE_RAMP 0.01 Nm/s; 0/65535 = 1

fields.name: inertia
fields.meaning: torque feed forward of the trajectory acceleration 0.0001 Nm/(turn/s^2); 0/65535 = 0

fields.name: vellimittol
fields.meaning: overspeed error above vel_limit times this, 0.01; 0/65535 = 120

fields.name: overspeederr
fields.meaning: enable_overspeed_error: 1 off, 2 on; 0/65535 = off

fields.name: torquevellim
fields.meaning: enable_torque_mode_vel_limit: 1 off, 2 on; 0/65535 = on

fields.name: phasel
fields.meaning: phase inductance uH; 0/65535 = 460

fields.name: poski
fields.meaning: position I: 0.1 rpm per (hall step * s), within 4 steps of the target; 0/65535 = 0 (off)

fields.name: poskd
fields.meaning: position D: 0.01 rpm per rpm of speed error (trajectory - wheel); 0/65535 = 0 (off)

fields.name: focspdkd
fields.meaning: FOC velocity D: 0.01 mA per rpm/s of the measured speed; 0/65535 = 0 (off)

fields.name: sinekd
fields.meaning: SINE_SPEED D: 0.01 permille modulation per rpm/s of the measured speed; 0/65535 = 0 (off)

fields.name: speedkd
fields.meaning: COM_SPEED D: 0.01 permille duty per rpm/s of the measured speed; 0/65535 = 0 (off)

fields.name: buzzerpassive
fields.meaning: buzzer without its own oscillator, driven with 2.2 kHz: 1 off, 2 on; 0/65535 = off

fields.name: chargelevel
fields.meaning: charger pin while the charger is connected: 1 low, 2 high; 0/65535 = high

fields.name: chargepull
fields.meaning: charger pin input: 1 floating, 2 pull-up, 3 pull-down; 0/65535 = floating

fields.name: chargelock
fields.meaning: no driving while the charger is connected: 1 off, 2 on; 0/65535 = off

fields.name: imusda
fields.meaning: IMU I2C SDA (PinFinder detect imu); read by the firmware at 0x68/0x69 (InvenSense register map), after a restart

fields.name: imuscl
fields.meaning: IMU I2C SCL

fields.name: imuaddr
fields.meaning: IMU 7 bit I2C address

fields.name: imuid
fields.meaning: IMU id register value (WHO_AM_I / CHIP_ID)

fields.name: hallang1
fields.meaning: angle (65536 per electrical turn) where hall state 1 starts, rising angle (calibrate hall); 0/65535 = built-in

fields.name: hallang2
fields.meaning: hall state 2 edge (calibrate hall)

fields.name: hallang3
fields.meaning: hall state 3 edge

fields.name: hallang4
fields.meaning: hall state 4 edge

fields.name: hallang5
fields.meaning: hall state 5 edge

fields.name: hallang6
fields.meaning: hall state 6 edge

fields.name: vbatgain
fields.meaning: battery divider in 0.001 (detect vbat <V>); 0/65535 = vbatdivider

fields.name: txpushpull
fields.meaning: uart TX push-pull: 2 = on (one board alone on the line, fast edges above 230400 baud), 1/0/65535 = open drain (shared bus line, needs a pull-up)

fields.name: hallinvert
fields.meaning: hall signals inverted (all three; a 180 deg el shift no pin order gives): 2 = on, 1/0/65535 = off; detect hall sets it

fields.name: extmagic
fields.meaning: 0xDCAD = extension record valid

fields.name: imumount
fields.meaning: IMU mounting (PinFinder calibrate imu): 1 + up*6 + forward, chip axes 0..5 = +x +y +z -x -y -z; 0/65535 = chip axes

fields.name: imurestx
fields.meaning: IMU gravity when level (calibrate imu), chip x, int16, 1024 = 1 g: zero pitch and roll

fields.name: imuresty
fields.meaning: IMU gravity when level, chip y

fields.name: imurestz
fields.meaning: IMU gravity when level, chip z

fields.name: ir1
fields.meaning: infrared foot sensor 1 (PinFinder detect ir; irmode)

fields.name: ir2
fields.meaning: infrared foot sensor 2

fields.name: irmode
fields.meaning: foot sensors, 4 bits each (ir1 bits 0-3, ir2 4-7): level while covered 1 low / 2 high (default high), + 4 x input 1 floating / 2 pull-up / 3 pull-down

fields.name: holdidle
fields.meaning: smart FOC position hold: d current at the target after holdidledelay, 0.1 A; pushed off the current rises again, full hold_current at 1.5 hall steps; 0/65535 = off (hold_current all the time)

fields.name: holdidledelay
fields.meaning: smart hold: ms in the target's hall sector before the current falls to holdidle (~4.4 A/s); 0/65535 = 500

fields.name: curpull
fields.meaning: phase current pullback limit 0.1 A: above it the current loop pulls the current back, no error; it only trips (curtrip, CURRENT_LIMIT_VIOLATION) if the current rises anyway; kept between focimax and curtrip; 0/65535 = 3/4 of curtrip

fields.name: templimit
fields.meaning: MCU temperature limit, C: above it INVERTER_OVER_TEMP and the gates off; 0/65535 = 85

fields.name: regenmax
fields.meaning: regenerated bus current limit, 0.1 A (from the phase currents): DC_BUS_OVER_REGEN_CURRENT; 0/65535 = off
